name: Pump Actions
description: Buttons and menu items for a pump analysis: show the next pump, open a page, clear markings and set a text property.

scripts.name: Next pump
scripts.description: Writes the pump after the current one into the document property ViewAsset, so every visual that filters on it shows that pump.

parameters.name: assets
parameters.description: Comma-separated pumps to step through, for example Pump A,Pump B.

scripts.name: Open page
scripts.description: Opens the page with the given title. When there is no such page, StatusMessage lists the pages.

parameters.name: pageTitle
parameters.description: Title of the page to open, for example Pump Detail.

scripts.name: Clear marking
scripts.description: Clears one or more markings in every data table.

parameters.name: markingNames
parameters.description: One marking name or several separated by commas, for example Marking, Event Pick.

scripts.name: Set text property
scripts.description: Writes a value into a String document property, only when the value changes, so its trigger script runs once per real change.

parameters.name: propertyName
parameters.description: Name of an existing String document property, for example ViewMode.

parameters.name: propertyValue
parameters.description: Text to write, for example Daily.
